properties.statement:
A WITHDRAWN NODE GOES ON RAISING GAPS, BECAUSE ONLY THE CAPABILITY DETECTORS CONSULT `discontinued`. Reported by dev_storyflow 2026-08-23.

THEIR CASE: they retired five DesignRules the sanctioned way — accepted Decision, `record_change` snapshotting first, then `OBSOLETES` to each rule. It worked; `get_node` returns `discontinued: true` on all five. AND EVERY ONE STILL RAISES ITS `unstated_rule_enforcement` GAP: 'does not say whether breaking it stops the build'. On a WITHDRAWN rule that question has no right answer — `enforced: true` bills a detector for an act nobody can perform, `enforced: false` records live advice about a system that no longer exists. They had to `acknowledge_gap` all five to clear the list.

CONFIRMED 2026-09-04: `is_discontinued` is defined at detect.rs:2341 and consulted in only four places — two of them keyed on `cap.node_id` (2378, 3281), one on an edge endpoint (2194), one at 4106. `unstated_rule_enforcement` is not among them. The code's OWN doc comment at detect.rs:2322 says it plainly: 'the three capability detectors fall silent'.

⭐ THE OMISSION IS VISIBLE IN `OBSOLETES`' OWN DESCRIPTION, which they quote: 'the unmotivated / unrealized / unverified capability gaps fall silent'. Three named CAPABILITY detectors, and nothing about any detector keyed on another type. The vocabulary advertises exactly what it does; nobody noticed it was a subset.

THEIR SUGGESTION IS ONE LINE: every detector should skip a `discontinued` node, or say why it does not. They also name the class correctly — it is the same shape as the staleness problem: THE GRAPH HOLDS THE FACT AND THE THING THAT READS IT DOES NOT CONSULT IT.

WORTH KEEPING FROM THE SAME ENTRY, as a thing that worked: `acknowledge_gaps`' bulk form insists on A REASON PER GAP, and writing five genuinely different reasons surfaced two stranded artifacts and a failing check hanging off a retired rule — all of which a single shared reason would have hidden. They ask for it to stay exactly as it is.

NOT ESTABLISHED: how many detectors are affected. Four call sites were counted; the total number of detectors that COULD be keyed on a discontinued node was not enumerated, so the blast radius is unmeasured.
